sources.title: Termsheet Please — Interactive Game
claims: The newly launched browser game Termsheet Please recreates the high-pressure environment of venture capital screening by casting players as investment partners vetting startup applications.
Players in Termsheet Please must review pitch decks, founder resumes, and market sizes to approve or reject early-stage startups within a limited daily time limit.

While Termsheet Please exaggerates the venture capital screening process for comedic effect, its core mechanics accurately reflect the strict filtering criteria used by accelerators like Y Combinator.
